title: Proper integral heart estimates and bounded-above cohomological amplitude
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ a finite intermediate extension in the fixed algebraic closure [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and $k$ a field of characteristic $p_0>0$ with $p_0\ne\ell$. Let $X$ be a separated finite-type $k$-scheme [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Write $\Lambda=\underline{\mathcal O_E}$ for the continuous condensed ring of integers, $\Lambda_X$ for its pullback to $X_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}}$, and $\mathcal A_X=\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_X}$ for its internal module category [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring] [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients] [sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. Let $H_X$ be the finite constant-model constructible predicate and $B_X$ the bounded constructible predicate in $D(\mathcal A_X)$ [sk-def-sfb-constructible] [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories]. Define $\operatorname{IndCons}_X=H_X.\mathrm{ind}$ using small filtered diagrams in the hom universe, and $\operatorname{Dic}_X=\{K\mid \forall n\in\mathbf Z,\ H^n(K)\in\operatorname{IndCons}_X\}$ [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $Y$ be another such $k$-scheme, let $p:X\to Y$ be a proper $k$-morphism, and let $d\in\mathbf N$ bound the Krull dimension of every geometric fibre [def-weil-proper-morphism] [def-pc-scheme-fibre] [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Write $F=Rp_*:D(\mathcal A_X)\to D(\mathcal A_Y)$ for ordinary total derived pushforward [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]. Then: (i) for $N\in H_X$, $F(N[0])\in B_Y\cap D^{\le 2d+1}$; (ii) for $N\in\operatorname{IndCons}_X$, every $H^q(F(N[0]))$ belongs to $\operatorname{IndCons}_Y$ and $F(N[0])\in D^{\le 2d+1}$; (iii) $F(B_X)\subseteq B_Y$; and (iv) for $K\in\operatorname{Dic}_X$ and $b\in\mathbf Z$ with $K\in D^{\le b}$, one has $F(K)\in D^{\le b+2d+1}$.

proof.text: The canonical exact integer-coefficient transport preserves bounded constructible complexes. Apply the integral proper preservation theorem in the completion presentation and transport back. Specialize to N[0] for the constructible cohomology conclusion.
Apply the constructible heart estimate to obtain the upper bound 2d+1.

Realize an Ind-constructible object as a small filtered colimit of constructible modules. Higher proper image commutes with this filtered colimit. Its values are therefore Ind-constructible and retain the same vanishing bound. The argument uses the coefficient-independent continuity helper, instantiated at the integral ring.

The integral Ind-heart is closed under kernels, cokernels and extensions. Use the coefficient-independent bounded-below hypercohomology argument to extend the upper bound from the heart to bounded-below complexes. Then use the left-complete lower truncation tower argument to remove the lower bound. These are generic private helpers, not the rational theorem specializations.

proof_origin.place: Proof (1)-(2); F5 formalization via integral coefficient transport, constructible heart bound, filtered continuity, hypercohomology and lower truncation towers

theorem integralProperCohomologicalBounds
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ)
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (p₀ : ℕ) [CharP k p₀] (hp₀ : 0 < p₀) (hpℓ : p₀ ≠ ℓ)
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (p : X ⟶ Y) [p.IsOver (Spec (.of k))] [IsProper p] (d : ℕ)
    (hd : ∀ y : Y, topologicalKrullDim
      (pullback p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap (Y.residueField y) (AlgebraicClosure (Y.residueField y)))) ≫
          Y.fromSpecResidueField y) : Scheme.{u}) ≤ (d : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    let Λ := Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E
    let A := Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X)
    let B := Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ Y)
    let F := (CondensedRing.lowerStar Λ p).rightDerivedFunctor
    (∀ N : A, IsConstantModelConstructible Λ X N →
      constantModelBoundedConstructible Λ Y (F.obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor A 0).obj N)) ∧
      (F.obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor A 0).obj N)).IsLE (2 * (d : ℤ) + 1)) ∧
    (∀ N : A, ObjectProperty.ind.{u + 1} (IsConstantModelConstructible Λ X) N →
      (∀ q : ℤ, ObjectProperty.ind.{u + 1} (IsConstantModelConstructible Λ Y)
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor B q).obj
          (F.obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor A 0).obj N)))) ∧
      (F.obj ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor A 0).obj N)).IsLE (2 * (d : ℤ) + 1)) ∧
    (∀ K : DerivedCategory A, constantModelBoundedConstructible Λ X K →
      constantModelBoundedConstructible Λ Y (F.obj K)) ∧
    (∀ (K : DerivedCategory A) (b : ℤ),
      (∀ n : ℤ, ObjectProperty.ind.{u + 1} (IsConstantModelConstructible Λ X)
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor A n).obj K)) →
      K.IsLE b → (F.obj K).IsLE (b + (2 * (d : ℤ) + 1)))
